title: Escalation Routing Rule R-011: IT system down reported
content:
ROUTING RULE: R-011 -- IT system down reported
TRIGGER TYPE: Incident
CONDITION: Workstation or HIS connectivity failure
ROUTE TO: IT and HIS Support (Extension 1033)
QUEUE: QUEUE_IT_SUPPORT
PRIORITY: URGENT
SLA: 1.0 hour(s)
ESCALATION RATIONALE: Hospital operational continuity at risk. ICU terminals get priority 1 dispatch within 15 minutes. Call IT helpline ext. 1033.
EXAMPLE QUERY 1: EMR workstation in ICU Bed 02 freezing
EXAMPLE QUERY 2: Cannot access HIS admission portal from counter
